summary.proof_note: Strictly monotone increasing transforms preserve the ROC curve and hence AUROC exactly; Platt (logistic) and temperature scaling are strictly monotone, so their per-class AUROC loss is 0. Isotonic regression is only weakly monotone (it can map distinct scores to equal values), so it can merge ties and reduce AUROC. RankSafe-Cal therefore always has at least two zero-AUROC-loss candidates available and selects the lowest-calibration-error option whose AUROC loss is within epsilon.
